newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland offers PLN 700 mln of 3-yr bonds April 22.
newsitem.headline: Poland offers PLN 700 mln of 3-yr bonds April 22.

text.p: The Polish finance ministry is offering 700 million zlotys worth of variable-interest three-year bonds at an auction for institutional investors on April 22, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said the bonds, maturing May 6, 2000, come from a 1.1 billion zloty issue. The rest of the issue will be offered to the public between May 5, 1997 and July 31, 1997.

The quarterly coupon of the bonds is the arythmetical average of average yields of 13-week T-bills from four consecutive auctions, the last of which was no later than two weeks before the coupon date, multiplied by 1.05.
